decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel remains central to the strategy of binding mobile communication, so its absence from the website more likely reflects rebranding within the integrated platform than a performance shortfall that would trigger search.
Mobile PDF signing supports the move toward online contract signing and costs little to maintain, though its lack of visibility since 2019 suggests modest results relative to aspirations.
The multi-layer architecture is essentially a framing of the core portfolio, so dropping it would free few resources even though it is no longer marketed separately.

The niche email-to-app robot has not been visible for two years, indicating results below aspiration, and three more years of uncertainty exhaust the slack-based patience, so its resources are better redirected to the core identity platform.

The payment compliance suite is peripheral and has faded from view, but regulatory demand in payments keeps it plausibly useful, so with current slack the firm carries it a little longer despite a high risk of withdrawal.
